    Outlier and influence diagnostics

    Source: R/meta-sensitivity.R
    meta_influence.Rd

    meta_influence() computes the case deletion diagnostics of Viechtbauer and Cheung (2010) for each study: externally studentised residuals, DFFITS, Cook's distance, covariance ratios, the leave-one-out \(\tau^2\) and Q, hat values, weights and DFBETAS. A study is flagged as influential when \(|DFFITS| > 3\sqrt{p/(k-p)}\), Cook's distance exceeds the median of a \(\chi^2_p\) distribution, the hat value exceeds \(3p/k\), or any \(|DFBETAS| > 1\).

    Usage

    meta_influence(.data)

    Arguments

    .data

    A <meta_fit> from meta_pool() or meta_regress().

    Value

    A tibble with one row per study and the columns study, rstudent, dffits, cooks_distance, cov_ratio, tau2_del, QE_del, hat, weight, dfbetas_<term> and influential.

    References

    Viechtbauer, W. and Cheung, M. W.-L. (2010). Outlier and influence diagnostics for meta-analysis. Research Synthesis Methods, 1(2), 112-125. doi:10.1002/jrsm.11

    Examples

    bcg <- meta_effect_size(bcg_trials, "RR",
  event1 = tpos, n1 = tpos + tneg, event2 = cpos, n2 = cpos + cneg,
  study = author
)
meta_pool(bcg) |> meta_influence()
